svg.aria-label: Four-wire coin cell holder: the upper and lower insulating jaws each have two contacts, a current contact I and a sense contact V. On top, the negative cap side connects to red CE and white RE; on the bottom, the positive case side connects to green WE and blue WS. The contact resistance of the contacts and leads is not included in the result. Before use, check that the contacts are clean and flat, and wipe them with isopropanol.
